title: Analysing Moral Bias in Finetuned LLMs through Mechanistic Interpretability
findings: The paper's findings are not related to religion. The study found that fine-tuned LLMs exhibit the Knobe effect, a moral bias that is localized in specific model layers and can be mitigated through targeted interventions (Layer-Patching).

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It measured the 'Knobe effect,' a cognitive bias in attributing intentionality based on the moral valence (positive vs. negative) of an action's side effects.
